raw_response: {"diagnosis": "silver_customers copies raw_customers.region without decoding it, so 4 customers carry numeric codes ('01' to '04') instead of region names. raw_region_map supplies a one-to-one code-to-name mapping (01 WEST, 02 EAST, 03 NORTH, 04 SOUTH), so the silver step should resolve codes through that map and keep existing names unchanged.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, COALESCE(m.region_name, upper(c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON c.region = m.region_code;"}}
